body:
Founder real-time: 'can we add diminishing marginal returns for the reward for pushing buttons?' The Nth button press this episode is now worth REWARD_BUTTON_PRESS_PER_TICK/N (harmonic decay), not a flat amount every time -- a real, gentle nudge against pure button-mashing while keeping the first press at full, undiminished magnitude (matching prior training runs' baseline). Movement stays flat per the ask's own specific scoping to buttons. Backward-compatible optional param (button_press_count=None keeps old flat behavior). 4 new tests, 103/103 total pass. Restarted the live training process using the newly-added --resume-from-registry flag so ~5 generations of accumulated progress were preserved rather than discarded.

⚓ ☃
title: S426: diminishing marginal returns on the button-press activity reward
